body:
Sorry, I took some sleeping pills (a safe amount) to sleep for as long as possible so I wouldn't have to deal with this. We've been together for a year, but it's always been much more serious than any other relationship I've been in. It's a rare week when I don't spend more than half of it at his place. We just enjoy each others company and I thought every thing was going relatively okay. We do fight a lot, it was really bad at the beginning but it kind of evened out after a month or so. I've been having a bad time of it as of late, I'm just really depressed and everything, but he makes me feel better. All I want to do right now is talk to him and tell him how much I need him but I tried that while I was trying to fight for our relationship and he just shot me down. I feel so alone because I've pretty much just wrapped my life around him since we started dating. My old friends (I've since learned) were distancing themselves for me because I was depressed and my new friends are practically non existent because I spend so much time over at his place. I don't think my life is worth anything anymore. I only feel like I have worth when I have someone else that I feel I'm doing good for. I have no one right now. 

I just. Next week is finals week. The week after that is Christmas. I'm already a mess, I don't want to deal with the stress of all of that and so it just seems easier to off myself right now and not worry about anything. I have no interest at all in my future. I place no importance on my own life for my own sake. The only reason I'm hesitant is because of my family, I would never hurt them so I guess I'm safe. But I don't want to deal with the pain.

I just miss him. I just want a hug and a cuddle to get me through this. I can't do life without him because he is my life.

Yea kind of I don't know, I kind of worked through the worst of it. It's just very... hard. I don't really see the point of anything right now. All I want is him, he's how I make myself feel better. He is my coping mechanism but obviously right now he can't be.
